test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster.

TREE : USDD :: SOAP : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95c040141babcba951951c0f8e9c11d8a9bf622850b42f0dc95784c360493773.png] ​

**Logic:** **1 is added in the first two alphabet positional values and 1 is subtracted in the last two alphabet positional values.**

TREE : USDD →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eae301dd505628742f0cd714ec5f8b5052f5f279aef28f9ffc9a61745c4fc310.png] 

Similarly, 'SOAP' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8175430f972e176bb1d5dac30f09b8ba9a76ba87c003873c1b941bbd00bef4b5.png] 

Here, 'SOAP' is coded as **'TPZO'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
